attributes.board_name: Missouri Board of Pharmacy (Division of Professional Registration)

rules.notes: Registration renews with an application and fee only, without a CE requirement: RSMo § 338.013.5 requires a renewal application and fee before expiry, and the technician registration rule (20 CSR 2220-2.700) sets no CE; continuing education (20 CSR 2220-7.080) applies to pharmacist licenses.
rules.rule_quote: 5. Every pharmacy technician who desires to continue to be registered as provided in this section shall, within thirty days before the registration expiration date, file an application for the renewal, accompanied by the fee prescribed by the board.
